text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Takarazuka Kinen, 
Winning Ticket enthusiastically promised 
her Trainer that she would definitely hype 
up the race.

And before the race, Winning Ticket told 
Biwa Hayahide that she wanted to give it 
her all and make it the "greatest race 
ever" that would move everyone to tears.

Though Biwa Hayahide felt something was 
off about those words, she expressed her 
resolve to give it her all. Their showdown 
was about to begin.
